notes: Background: Solaris Core builds routing optimization and ETA prediction for 3PL and last-mile fleets. Heavy use of reranking + embeddings for search across manifests and route histories.
Primary ask: Dedicated capacity with throughput guarantees for peak planning windows (early morning batch + 12:00 dispatch surge). Need predictable p50/p95 token latency and sustained throughput.
Security: must run in VPC with customer-controlled KMS; audit logs forwarded to Splunk; retention and deletion policy required (90 days initially).
Quote from CTO (1/22 call): "We cannot accept a noisy neighbor scenario during dispatch. If you promise 400 concurrent generation streams, we need evidence via soak.
Cost sensitivity: willing to commit to a 12-month reserved pool if latency and unit-cost targets met. Prefers model quantization suggestions from Redwood Optimize.
Decision team: CTO + Head of ML (Eva Liao) + Infrastructure Director (Ravi Patel) + Procurement. Procurement timeline: March end for FY cycle.
Notes on previous vendors: tested self-hosted Llama at scale; observability poor, autoscale brittle. Interested in Redwood's rolling fallback for capacity shortages.
POC scope agreed: 4-week test window on dedicated pool, including load test and 7-day soak with representative production workloads.

poc_summary: Duration: 4 weeks on Redwood Dedicated pool (staged).
Goals: validate throughput guarantees, verify p50/p95 latency SLOs, confirm autoscaling/burst behavior and fallback correctness.
Deliverables: load test report, 7-day soak logs, KV/prefix cache hit analysis, cost-per-1M-token estimate under observed workload.
Success metric: sustain 18k tokens/sec aggregate on provisioned pool with p95 generation latency <= 420ms for chat flows and reranking throughput of 2k qps for short sequences.
load_test_requirements: Simulate peak morning batch + midday dispatch surge concurrently (mix: 60% embeddings/batch, 30% reranking, 10% chat).
Warmup phase: 30 minutes at 50% target throughput, then 2-hour ramp to 100% sustained.
Measure: throughput, token/sec, p50/p90/p95 latency, GPU utilization, kernel contention metrics, error rates.
Include tests with KV cache cold vs warm, and with quantized model variant to compare CPU/GPU throughput.
Traffic shaping to reproduce request length distribution captured during technical deep-dive.
soak_test_requirements: 7-day continuous soak at 70% of peak capacity to observe resource leakage, memory growth, and tail latency drift.
Nightly 3-hour spike injections to validate autoscale and burst behavior without impacting SLOs.
Record rolling restarts and model reload times; verify automatic fallback to smaller model variant within SLA policy.
Generate daily summary: token count, average cost, incidents/exceptions, cache hit rate.
representative_prompts: rerank: 'Given candidate deliveries, rank by ETA accuracy and historical delay probability. Provide top-3 and confidence scores.'
chat: 'Driver: I have a route deviation, suggest alternative route and estimated time delta based on traffic.'
embeddings: 'Make 512-dim embeddings for 100k manifest lines; measure batching throughput.'
search: 'Find most similar previous shipment that had a package with comparable dimension and delay pattern.'
sla_requirements: p50 generation latency targets: chat <= 120ms, reranking <= 160ms for short sequences (<= 128 tokens).
p95 generation latency targets: chat <= 420ms, reranking <= 600ms under provisioned capacity.
Uptime SLA: 99.9% for the dedicated control plane; 99.5% for model serving during business hours (06:00-22:00 local).
Credit structure: service credits if p95 latency misses more than 3 days in a 30-day window, plus remediation plan requirement.
Security SLAs: response time for critical incidents <= 1 hour; weekly audit log export guarantee.
reserved_gpu_plan: Initial commit: 8x A100-equivalent GPUs reserved (12-month), allow burst pool of +2 GPUs for 30 minutes per burst event.
Autoscale policy: scale to burst pool up to 30% of baseline for sustained 10-minute spikes, then fallback to canary model routing.
Quantization note: test int8 and bfloat16 profiles recommended by Redwood Optimize; compare perf and quality tradeoffs.
Migration window: schedule two maintenance nights for on-prem connector installation and network rules (customer prefers weekends).
acceptance_criteria: Load test shows sustained throughput >= targets with p95 latencies inside SLA for 3 consecutive run windows.
7-day soak demonstrates stable memory and CPU/GPU utilization with no regressions in cache behavior.
Security checklist items signed off: KMS integration validated, SOC2 evidence provided, SSO test passed.
Cost model: estimated cost per 1M tokens within 15% of proposal and procurement approves ARR commit.
